chapter: Midwest bands: Hardy Brothers, Helvey and Buffalo
title: Theater tour and lining up work in Cincinnati with Zack White and Wesley Helvey
summary: The show took them to theaters in Cincinnati, Cleveland and Detroit; Jones used the stops to contact the best local leaders, Zack White and Wesley Helvey, in case of openings.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So we went in there, and we stayed I guess about two months. Now, coming on back home, well I wasn't too particular coming back home. So they get to talking about -- they were out of Richmond. Said, "If we go back to Richmond you'll love it. We've got it locked up around there. We have the -- gigs all the time, you know." And they'd be talking and I'd be listening, you know, and so -- but I'm a little smarter now, see, because Horace said, "Well, don't worry about it. When we leave here we're going into Cincinnati, a colored theater there, and I think it was the Roosevelt or something like that, for a week, and the next week we're going to the Globe Theater in Cleveland, and then when we leave there we're going to Detroit, there's another theater in the black neighborhood." So that's three weeks, so we said we'll stick it out, we'll try this, you know.

So they got the chorus girls, the whole show and everything, you know, and all we had to do was to play for it. We did this, but while in Cincinnati, I contacted Wesley Helvey (PHONETIC) and Zack White. These guys had the two best
Was Zack White a piano player?

Zack White, he was the leader of the band. That's with Sy Oliver, and all of them guys played with you know, a lot of those guys come up with that band, Zack White. Then you had another one called Wesley Helvey's Troubadors. That was -- Vic played with that, Vic Dickenson, , Frankie Newton, Bill Coleman. And --
They'd come up with the kid band and gone on to them?
No, see they weren't in the kid -- Vic wasn't in the kid band.
No, Bill Coleman wasn't either. None of these guys in Helvey's band. They wasn't. See, they -- I'm just telling you about these two bands.
Being in town. And what I'm doing, I'm contacting them and telling them, you know, I may not be with this band long, you know, so if you've got an opening or something, you know.
